settings.heading: Four steps to a very good day
settings.text: You don't pick the flowers. You pick the box, set your no-list, and we do the rest.

settings.heading: Pick your box
settings.text: Flowers, plants, or both. Every box is £35, one-off or on repeat.

settings.heading: Set your no-list
settings.text: Up to three colours and four varieties you'd rather not receive, plus pet and allergy needs.

settings.heading: We pack it fresh
settings.text: Our Dutch growers fill your box the morning it leaves, working around your list.

settings.heading: Open the lid
settings.text: Film it, tag us, collect loyalty points — and check inside for a Golden Ticket.

settings.heading: The only thing you choose is what you don't want
settings.text: On every product page you'll find the box builder. Tick the colours and varieties to leave out, flag allergies or pets, choose whether you'd like a clue before delivery, and pick your date. Everything else stays sealed until the lid comes off.

settings.name: De Vries Family
settings.text: Third-generation rose growers. What doesn't meet the auction grade goes straight into your box.

settings.name: Kwekerij Bloem
settings.text: Tulips by the million every spring. We take the surplus the day it's cut.

settings.name: Van Dijk Planten
settings.text: House plants grown slowly, in peat-free compost, under Dutch glass.

settings.question: Can I choose what's in my box?
settings.answer: Not exactly — that's the whole point. What you can do is tell us what to leave out: up to three colours and four varieties, plus needs like pet-friendly or low pollen.

settings.question: How many stems do I get?
settings.answer: Typically 15–25 stems, depending on the varieties available that week. Plant boxes contain two to four plants.

settings.question: What if I don't like what arrives?
settings.answer: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll put it right. Our 7-day freshness promise covers any stem that doesn't last the week.

settings.question: Can I get a clue first?
settings.answer: Yes. On the box builder you can ask for the main colour or one variety to be revealed the day before delivery — or keep it completely sealed.

settings.heading: Ready for a very good surprise?
